notes.content: Continuation of a connectedness assertion under properness, followed by Corollaire 5 on surjectivity of fundamental groups. A motivating paragraph asks for a non-generic analogue and larger quotients. Théorème 6 gives hypotheses on algebraically closed k, proper X, f:X→P^r, a linear L_t and a closed D: nonempty Y_t, smoothness/codimension and f net, and a condition on D_t involving codimension at least two or a normal-crossings divisor. The final paragraph assumes U=X-D irreducible and defines two tame quotients. The text breaks after homomor-. These are document claims, not theorems verified in this run.
written_reservations_and_slips: No explicit authorial doubt statement is written; all unsure markers in reading.tex are this reader’s uncertainties.
danonique, sous -espace, net, the overwritten internal spelling of codimension, and the mixed word before X en x are retained from ink.
The motivating paragraph says sans hypothèse de propreté while the theorem writes X propre; this is preserved without repair.
The cancelled parenthetical phrase is incomplete and has no visible closing parenthesis.
The marginal reference is copied from its shapes; no publication/reference lookup was made.
notes.titles_dates_counts: Numbered internal headings Corollaire 5 and Théorème 6; no separate page title, date, stated total count, or own page number. Bottom-left 113 is an archive sheet number. References 2, 3/4, 5 and SCA/SGA 1 X 2... are not dates or page counts.
mathematical_considerations: No mathematical identity, expected theorem, reference history, or grammatical completion was used to settle an unclear glyph.

Potentially decisive places were inspected because of their role: the cancelled intersection cell, corrected codimension object, slanted inequality, cancelled D subscript, extra upper mark over pi, and U/V argument.
The greater-or-equal sign has a slanted lower stroke; this is a shape correction without change of relation.
No proof check, re-proof, computation, or external theorem verification was performed.
notes.coverage: Every word shared by C and H was also compared with the original-resolution halves, including accents, indices, formulas, punctuation, and endings. Only places left open there were cropped. Each of 16 crops was generated once and viewed once; the whole image and each half were viewed once, in separate calls. The ti at the line break in surjectivité was open initially and resolved by crop 16 without a transcription difference.
notes.conventions: Handwritten wrappers do not by themselves create H differences. H’s displayed corollary formula and bold heading rendering differ in placement/emphasis from the ordinary type and underline visible here. An absent extraction page macro is not counted as an omission of archive 113. The final image fragment homomor- is recorded in notes; its layout hyphen is suppressed in reading.tex under the join-line convention, and no next-page continuation is supplied.
notes.scope_and_inputs: Only brief_v08, PREAMBLE, the assigned meta/C/H/prior-question/notation files, and this scan’s three supplied images were read. No other reader output, other page, OCR, recognition tool, external research, or further agent was used. The supplied prior questions all concerned this scan. Marginal line colors are qualitative reproductions, not material identifications.
notes.nonverbal_marks: Three independent margin strokes are drawn with their visible geometry and tonal differences. Two detached points below the corrected codimension object are embedded geometrically in that formula; their significance and maker are not asserted.
